messages: Let's meet #b#p226##k the Security Guy at the #m10001100#.

At the Dungeon Entrance, I met #p226#, the guard. He told me that he wanted to make a nourishing snack for his mother and asked me to hunt #r20 #o18#s#k and #r20 #o17#s#k and bring back #b10 #t4000018#s#k, #b10 #t4000017#s#k, and #b1 #t2020000##k. He said he's too busy with his guard duties to do it himself... but, honestly, he looks like he's sleeping on the job!!

I got #p226#, who protects the entrance of the dungeon, the stuff he asked for. Since he was already making the Snake Drink and all... I wanted a taste for myself! In return, #p226# gave me a nicely refined jewel he found around the area. It's not like refined jewels fall from the sky... Did someone lose it while traveling? Anyway, I should drop by later when the Snake Drink is ready...
name: Luke the Security Guy
